Advanced LRU Cache with Time-To-Live (TTL) Expiry and Thread Safety.

This module provides a robust implementation of a Least Recently Used (LRU) cache
that supports Time-To-Live (TTL) expiration for individual entries. It is designed
to be thread-safe, making it suitable for concurrent environments.

Features:
1. LRU Eviction: When the cache reaches its maximum capacity, the least recently
   used item is evicted to make room for new items.
2. TTL Expiry: Each cached item can have an associated Time-To-Live (TTL).
   If an item's age exceeds its TTL, it is considered expired and will not be
   returned upon access. Expired items are lazily removed or can be cleaned up
   proactively.
3. Thread Safety: All public methods are protected by a reentrant lock to ensure
   safe concurrent access from multiple threads.
4. Callbacks: Supports on-hit, on-miss, on-eviction, and on-expiry callbacks for
   monitoring and debugging purposes.
5. Custom Key and Value Types: Generic types for flexibility.

Architecture:
- _Node: Internal doubly-linked list node for O(1) LRU operations.
- _CacheMap: Dictionary mapping keys to nodes for O(1) lookup.
- LRUCacheWithTTL: The main cache class managing state, locks, and logic.
- ThreadSafeLRUCacheWithTTL: A wrapper providing explicit thread-safety guarantees
  and additional monitoring features.
